text: The physical exam findings you described—epicanthus, upward slanting eyelids, low-set ears, a single transverse palmar crease, and a holosystolic murmur—are highly suggestive of Down syndrome (Trisomy 21), not gastroenteritis. While Down syndrome patients can have GI issues, the specific combination of bilious vomiting and family history of pyloric stenosis makes me suspicious of a structural defect like duodenal atresia or malrotation.
